title: Magajin da aka Naɗa
intro: Wani mutum daga zamanin da ya gabata yana shirye ya shiga tarihi. Lokacin da hanyar ta yi kama da ba a san ta ba kuma shakku ya bazu a tsakanin mutane, an zaɓi wannan bawan don ya ɗauki nauyin jagora. Da nauyin wani aiki mai tsarki a kafaɗunsu, suka taka gaba don jagorantar inda wasu suka yi jinkirin bi.
clues: An zaɓe ni in raka wani annabi kuma na koyi daga hikimarsu
Na tsaya a gaban Akwatin lokacin da alkawarin Ubangijinmu ya gabato, sai na ga mutane sun fara shakka
An sa ni tsaye a gefen abin da aka yi alkawari yayin da shugabanmu ke baƙin ciki da roƙon Allah a gare mu.
An naɗa ni don in ci gaba da aikin da aka ba wani kafin ni
An ba ni ikon Allah na jagorantar mutane zuwa inda suke so
Na yi nasarar kammala abin da aka fara a gabana, kuma na sami amincewar mutane game da jagora na

arabic: يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْضَ ٱلْمُقَدَّسَةَ ٱلَّتِى كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ وَلَا تَرْتَدُّوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَدْبَارِكُمْ فَتَنقَلِبُوا۟ خَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: O my people, enter the blessed land [i.e., Palestine] which Allāh has assigned to you and do not turn back [from fighting in Allāh's cause] and [thus] become losers." (5:21)
